title: Measuring What Matters: The AI Pluralism Index

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing public documentation to assess language coverage in user interfaces, support channels, and documentation, specifically checking for the inclusion and support of low-resource languages rather than just high-income market languages.

Reviewing public artifacts to evaluate the presence of accessibility features, verifiable claims of conformance to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.2), and independent accessibility verification for user-facing interfaces.

Evaluating whether AI producers publish structured documentation of dataset demographics, sampling frames, and disaggregated evaluation results that report model performance and safety metrics across different population subgroups.
